Pro Nail Tech Program

Published curriculum from the original Nail Revolution website. Current fees, duration, assessment and certification must be confirmed with the academy.

*Module 1: Advanced Nail Shapes*
- Detailed study of advanced nail shapes (e.g., edge, lipstick, flare)
- Techniques for creating and customizing nail shapes
​
*Module 2: Advanced Nail Anatomy*
- In-depth understanding of nail structure and function
- Nail health and common nail disorders
​
*Module 3: Advanced Types of Nails*
- Advanced study of natural nails vs. artificial nails
- Specialty nails (e.g., fiberglass, silk wraps)
​
*Module 4: Advanced Nail Prep*
- Advanced techniques for preparing natural nails
- Nail prep for complex nail designs
​
*Module 5: Gel Polish Application Techniques*
- Advanced gel polish application techniques (e.g., color blending, layering)

​
*Module 6: Advanced Gel Extensions*
- Advanced procedures for gel extensions (e.g., dual forms, sculpting)

​
*Module 7: Advanced Acrylic Extensions*
- Advanced techniques for acrylic extensions (e.g., 3D designs, encapsulation)
- Creating custom acrylic designs
​
*Module 8: Refilling Techniques*
- Advanced refilling techniques for acrylic, gel, and poly gel extensions
- Maintaining the integrity and strength of nail enhancements
​
*Module 9: Advanced Feet Nail Extensions*
- Techniques for extending toenails with various materials
- Pedicure techniques for extended toenails
​
*Module 10: Form Extensions*
- Detailed procedure for creating nail extensions using forms
- Advanced shaping and sculpting techniques
​
*Module 11: Poly Gel Extensions*
- Step-by-step procedure for poly gel extensions
- Advantages and applications of poly gel
​
*Module 12: Gel Polish Removal*
- Advanced gel polish removal techniques
- Minimizing damage and maintaining nail health
​
*Module 13: Extension Removal*
- Advanced methods for removing various types of extensions
- Dealing with challenging removal scenarios
​

This Pro Nail Tech Program offers a comprehensive and detailed curriculum covering a wide range of advanced nail technology topics, including advanced nail shapes, nail anatomy, types of nails, nail prep, gel and acrylic extensions, refilling techniques, feet nail extensions, form extensions, poly gel extensions, gel polish and extension removal, and a variety of advanced nail art techniques. Each module can be further expanded with detailed lessons, demonstrations, and hands-on practice sessions to ensure mastery of the topics.
